research_question: Can core-strength-tiered protection preserve validation evidence from ordinary winners while granting only established strong winners enough room for 40-day continuation?

data_contract.event_conflict_rule: zero curated official events in the frozen 20-calendar-day lookback
data_contract.protection_tiers: 5-to-15-percent core winners use 5-percent stop and 15/5 trailing protection; core winners at or above 15 percent use 10-percent stop and 50/15 trailing protection
data_contract.exit_timing: all stop and trailing decisions use prior close and execute on the next available close
data_contract.baseline_buy_freeze: candidate may buy only the exact signal/rank/symbol set actually executed by frozen V3
data_contract.substitution_rule: fund frozen V3 buys from the weakest prior-close ordinary position while retaining the external winner

model.target: 40-day deferred-exit close return minus frozen mechanical-exit close return
model.target_availability: deferred label joins only after its exit day is strictly before the current decision
model.core_features: position path, rank and V3 entry price-volume features
model.full_features: core plus PIT global, SW L1, macro and event-conflict features
model.external_increment: full ridge prediction minus core ridge prediction

selection.standout_gate: at least 10 percent relative return improvement, or one fewer negative month together with improved drawdown
selection.robustness_requirement: formal pass still requires trigger-level concentration and execution stress audits before any paper challenger
